blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions alliance with IBM: what is certified, how joint deliveries run, and the scenarios this page can be held to.

IBM in one line: Hybrid infrastructure, watsonx AI and mainframe-era modernization. The alliance is delivery-grade, not logo-grade — joint reference architectures, certified engineers on both sides, and escalation paths that reach the vendor's own platform team when it matters.

blocks.x: Under the hood, chosen for operability rather than novelty:

items: Watsonx
Governed model lifecycle for regulated estates — tuning, evaluation and deployment in one audited place.
Db2 And Zsystems Integration
The mainframe stays the system of record; we integrate it without copying it into the dark.
Planning Analytics
Finance's planning models wired into the same numbers operations uses — one version of the plan.
Qradar Telemetry Into The Detection Graph
SIEM events joined into the detection graph — correlated, deduplicated and owned.
Trusted Execution
Sensitive compute isolated in attested environments — the operator of the platform is not a party to the data.
cost-aware clustering
Workloads land on the cheapest compute that still meets the latency budget.
dbt transformation graph
Tested, documented models with lineage exposure — the transform layer your analysts can actually read.
Delta / Iceberg tables
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
freshness SLOs
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.

blocks.x: Joint delivery on IBM Alliance is designed for handover from the first week — runbooks written as we go, decisions mapped to your owners, nothing that only we can operate.
Artifacts, not anecdotes — at the first-quarter close your team holds:

items: Joint architecture pack
The target architecture drawn against your estate, with interfaces and owners made explicit.
Certified delivery pod
A named team with the clearances your estate requires — the same people from diagnosis to handover.
Support map
Who answers when something breaks — named roles, response expectations and the escalation path.

blocks.x: Ask for the IBM reference pack — or bring your use case to a joint working session with both platform teams.
